messages:
jess-support: Customer reported their incremental usage export omitted ~6k events for 2025-12-31 which explains invoice delta vs dashboard. They attached CSV and say the missing rows were generated after 23:45 UTC but before midnight.
raj-eng: can you paste the CSV sample and the invoice id?
lina-billing: invoice  INV-2025-12-31-8893, customer says exported file shows 2025-12-31 up to 23:45 but dashboard shows activity until 23:59.
anna-support: here's the sample row from their CSV: 
```
customer_id,ts,tokens
acme-42,2025-12-31T23:45:12Z,312
acme-42,2025-12-31T23:46:03Z,128   <-- MISSING
```
raj-eng: thanks. ops-bot just posted: job export-incremental-20251231 finished with code 0 at 23:46:00 UTC, but commit timestamp is 2025-12-31T23:45:00Z 
ops-bot: [automated] export-runner: wrote shard s3://exports/2025/12/31/part-3.csv size=1.2MB commit_ts=2025-12-31T23:45:00Z
jess-support: so looks like exporter cut-off was at commit_ts not event_ts. customer events arriving late were processed but committed with earlier watermark?
raj-eng: probable. can someone run the query to find rows with event_ts between 23:45 and 23:59 that were ingested before midnight but committed earlier? use: 
```
SELECT count(*) FROM usage_events
WHERE customer_id='acme-42' AND event_ts >= '2025-12-31T23:45:00Z' AND event_ts < '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' AND commit_ts <= '2025-12-31T23:45:00Z';
```
eng-oncall: running now, ETA ~2m
eng-oncall: result = 6123 rows (matching missing count). appears commit_ts watermark truncation bug.
lina-billing: that matches invoice delta. customer billed for tokens from those 6123 events in next day's billing bucket, causing mismatch vs export.
anna-support: customer is upset, wants corrected CSV and credit. recommended action?
raj-eng: short-term: generate a backfill export for 2025-12-31 including events where event_ts in that window regardless of commit_ts. add note to filename. medium-term: fix export-runner to use event_ts watermark or include late-arrival window.
eng-oncall: I'll kick off backfill job now: backfill-export --day=2025-12-31 --force --include-late-window=00:15 --target=s3://exports/backfills/2025-12-31-late/
ops-bot: backfill job queued job_id=bf-20251231-77
eng-oncall: queued, ETA 18m. after complete we'll notify accounting for invoice adjustment / credit for the customer.
jess-support: I'll tell customer we've queued a backfill and accounting will review credit. sorry for the trouble :pray: 
raj-eng: creating PR to adjust cutoff logic, adding unit + integration test for commit vs event watermark. tag @eng-oncall for rollout.
lina-billing: leaving a note on invoice INV-2025-12-31-8893 pending adjustment, will await backfill CSV before issuing credit.
anna-support: customer acknowledged and provided manifest of missing rows, appreciates the quick follow-up :thumbsup:
eng-oncall: backfill completed job_id=bf-20251231-77 status=success wrote s3://exports/backfills/2025-12-31-late/part-0.csv size=2.1MB
ops-bot: [automated] checksum ok, manifest updated.
raj-eng: marking as incident candidate for postmortem, root cause = export-runner used commit_ts watermark. will schedule postmortem doc.
jess-support: closing loop with customer, will attach new CSV and ask if they want invoice credit now or after accounting calculates final delta.
anna-support: thanks everyone, logging thread for follow-up tasks.
